title: Step functions: static and dynamic
summary:
This is an example for the element step function. The first step function is just a static example. The second step function is dynamic and depends on the y-coordinate of the free point and the JavaScript function . The function will be updated whenever the point is dragged.
There is no real application for this, but it shows the dynamic nature of JSXGraph.
